items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Tony Scodwell was one of the great trumpet players, a Vegas guy that makes my horns, he’s an incredible guy.

ctx.x: I can — you know like you know a lot of people say, “God, you play that just like Harry.” I say no you don’t. You don’t play it like Harry.” Tony Scodwell was one of the great trumpet players, a Vegas guy that makes my horns, he’s an incredible guy. He was with Harry. And Tony told me, he says, “Nobody plays like Harry but you know what you do Fred? You have the spirit of Harry James. You have that spirit.” Nobody plays like Harry James man. Technically, anything. I don’t care who you are.
When you get a concert to do and you have to plug in a few players, is there something you say to them to get them in the spirit of the Harry James sound?
